description.sub_name: 電漿技術於半導體產業之應用
description.sub_ename: APPLICATIONS OF PLASMA TECHNOLOGY ON SEMICONDUCTOR INDUSTRIAL
description.describe_ch: 本課程對於半導體產業上所應用之電漿技術作深入淺出之介紹，課程包含電漿技術介紹(如電漿沉積薄膜技術: PVD/PECVD、電漿蝕刻、電漿清洗與電漿活化等) 以及半導體產業介紹，期能幫助學生了解電漿技術以及半導體產業，以利爾後就業以及升學。
description.describe_eh: This class fully introduce the applications of plasma technology on semiconductor industrial. This class covers the introduction of plasma technology (including plasma vapor deposition of thin films: PVD/CVD, plasma etching, plasma cleaning and plasma activation) and the introduction of semiconductor industrial. This class can help students to realize plasma technology and semiconductor industrial and further assists the job career and the study in graduate school.
